newsitem.title: SPAIN: Citibank to issue call, put on Telefonica.
newsitem.headline: Citibank to issue call, put on Telefonica.

text.p: Citibank Espana will issue up to three million American-style put and call warrants in six separate tranches on Telefonica de Espana shares, according to the prospectus presented to stock market commission CNMV.
Each tranche size will be up to a maximum of 500,000 warrants. The issue and strike prices will be announced on the issue day.

The strike price will be referenced to the retail price set for the current privatisation of the state's remaining 20.9 percent in the telecommunications company. The Telefonica share sale will be completed on February 18.
The warrants will be issued on February 18, 1997 and will mature on February 18, 1998.
The issuance requires authorisation from the CNMV.
Each warrant will give the right to sell (PUT) or to buy (CALL) one Telefonica share at a pre-set strike price.
The minimum purchase is 100 warrants. The warrants will be listed on the Madrid stock exchange. The pay day will be two working days after the issuance.
